key_conclusion: Current Planning is narrow by leaf-path width but heavy by event cardinality, narrative bytes, cross-segment constraints and whole-object recovery atomicity. Runtime bookkeeping is already mostly deterministic; V2 should stop asking the model to reproduce the five authority/local leaf paths.
